agency_levels.L2: Prepare reversible action; execution requires separate authorization.
agency_levels.L3: Execute bounded reversible action within explicit scope.
agency_levels.L4: Execute multi-step workflow within explicit scope and authority.
agency_levels.L5: Delegate/coordinate only when delegation authority is explicitly granted.

laws: Effective agency must be explicitly granted; capability never raises agency.
Requested action level must be <= granted agency.
Authorization must bind actor, action, resource, scope, and time.
A retry of materially equivalent work is forbidden unless new information changes the test, inputs, authority, or causal hypothesis.
After three materially equivalent failures, strategy reassessment is mandatory.
